summary.oneLiner:
33rd AGM of a very small (~₹16.6 crore market cap, 1.7 crore shares) BSE-only company. Management
called FY26 operating performance "satisfactory" but disclosed **zero quantified financials** on the
call itself (deferring "detailed financial highlights" to the Annual Report, not read into the
transcript). The only forward-looking statement was a vague **"strategic shift"**: management said it
is "consciously evolving our corporate mandate," strengthening existing operations while "actively
exploring new, value-accretive business opportunities," and is "institutionalizing internal core
capabilities" by hiring "fresh, data-driven analyst talent" this year. No specifics (business line,
sector, quantum, timeline) were given for what the new opportunities might be.
